$comment: Suite model-card/v1 (v6.3 M2b): the pairings of contracts/semantics/model_pairings.json (O03), parameters shared within one model, observation use within a joint evaluation (R-AUX) and cross-model sharing. Not supported: shapes, multivariate constraints, joint evaluations of several cards (undefined cross-model merges), full HistFactory. Version 1.1.0 (release R3, stable; the default suite from R3): check-context 1.1.0; the R2 and R3 rule fixes and, for counting-chain, r-real.undescribed on generator 1.1.0 (see contracts/rules/registry.json). The 1.0.0 suite names rule versions this checker no longer runs (check.rule_not_run); reproduce 1.0.0 results with release R1.
not_supported: joint evaluations of several model cards (no combiner contract)
